title: Seed Bound for the Quadratic Pair Tester
statement: For every natural number $d$, the seed space of the Boolean-valued tester obtained by combining the linearity, matrix-linearity, and rank-one tests on quadratic-character addresses has cardinality at most $3\cdot 2^{3(d+1)^2}$.
